tasks.label: QLCC: Docker - build and start
tasks.detail: Start the application at http://localhost:5000. Frontend edits appear after a browser reload.

tasks.label: QLCC: Tailwind - build CSS
tasks.detail: Compile Tailwind after npm ci. Generated file: frontend/styles.css.

tasks.label: QLCC: Tailwind - watch CSS
tasks.detail: Keep this task running while editing frontend files; refresh the browser after saving.

tasks.label: QLCC: Database - check Docker database
tasks.detail: Read-only audit of the shared Docker database. Local files are listed separately; no data is merged.

tasks.label: QLCC: Python - run local services
tasks.detail: Development only: uses a separate Windows database, not Docker Live data. Requires Python setup and free ports 5000-5008.
